title: Malacañang fires back at Sara Duterte's spox: ‘Absolutely delusional’
summary: Malacañang on Tuesday took a swipe at Vice President Sara Duterte’s newly appointed spokesman over statements criticizing President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and calling for his resignation.
